baseline_models.focus_anchor: The negated predicate at focus word 5 stands in the construction 'not ... upon Allah.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The severe-impact branch makes the demonstrative matter a burden whose difficulty is denied relative to Allah.

activation_trace.role: The severe-impact and difficulty branch supplies the denied burden.

changed_reading.before: Aziz is heard only as an honorific meaning mighty or honorable.
changed_reading.after: The unspecified matter does not weigh as a difficult or severe undertaking upon Allah.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus predicate at word 5 can describe rarity and resistance to attainment.
baseline_models.mechanism: Negation removes scarcity or inaccessibility from the demonstrative: no needed outcome lies beyond Allah's reach as a rare object would.

activation_trace.role: The rarity and hard-to-attain branch turns difficulty into denied inaccessibility.

changed_reading.before: The matter is merely said to be easy.
changed_reading.after: The matter is denied the status of a scarce or unobtainable outcome for Allah.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root at word 5 includes prevailing over an opponent and an affair becoming dominant.
baseline_models.mechanism: The negation denies that the demonstrative either defeats Allah from outside or grows into an intractable affair that masters its agent.

activation_trace.role: The prevailing-over-an-opponent branch supplies the adversarial resistance being denied.
The branch of an affair becoming dominant supplies the intractability being denied.

changed_reading.after: The matter cannot become an opponent or runaway affair that overmasters Allah.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus predicate at word 5 has a material branch of hard ground and cohesive matter.
baseline_models.mechanism: The demonstrative is pictured as lacking compact solidity that would make an operation meet an unyielding substrate.

activation_trace.role: The hard-ground and cohesion branch supplies a material image of denied resistance.

changed_reading.before: Difficulty is an abstract measure of effort.
changed_reading.after: The matter presents no compact, unyielding resistance before Allah.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding ayah resolves the demonstrative as a compound replacement operation: willing the present addressees away and bringing a newly originated creation.

activation_trace.role: The difficulty branch states what is denied of the resolved replacement operation.
The volitional branch makes divine willing the initiating condition.
The originating branch supplies both the prior creation and its produced replacement.
The going-away branch supplies removal of the current human term.
The newness-after-severance branch marks a fresh term after discontinuity.

structural_cues: 14:19 immediately precedes 14:20, whose opening demonstrative points backward.
14:19 coordinates removal and new creation before 14:20 evaluates 'that.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adjacency, the demonstrative, and the remove/bring sequence; I infer that the demonstrative gathers the sequence into one operation. A live alternative is that it points only to bringing a new creation.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified matter is not difficult for Allah.
changed_reading.after: Removing the present people and replacing them with a freshly originated creation is not difficult for Allah.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah predicates Aziz of Allah while denying aziz of the replacement relative to Allah, creating an asymmetry between an unconquered agent and a non-conquering task.

activation_trace.role: The focus prevailing branch supplies the resistance denied of the task.
The same root as a divine predicate supplies Allah's prevailing side of the asymmetry.
The right-judging wisdom branch makes the prevailing agency ordered rather than merely forceful.
The later divine predicate renews supremacy before the earth-replacement scene.
The punishment-after-rejection branch gives prevailing power an executed consequence.

structural_cues: The same root is positive of Allah in 14:4 and 14:47 but negated of 'that' relative to Allah in 14:20.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated root and opposite predicative placement; I infer relational wordplay in which Allah's Aziz status prevents the task from being aziz against him. Alternatively, the repetitions may be independent uses.

changed_reading.before: The verse offers a generic assertion of divine ability.
changed_reading.after: The One who prevails cannot be prevailed over by the replacement he wills.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated reliance 'upon Allah' turns the focus frame from detached capacity into assurance for agents entrusting their threatened future to him.

activation_trace.role: The denied-difficulty branch guarantees that the entrusted outcome does not burden Allah.
The repeated dependence branch supplies the act of placing the threatened matter upon Allah.
The injurious-harm branch supplies the pressure under which reliance is exercised.
The outward-expulsion branch makes loss of place the concrete threat entrusted to Allah.

structural_cues: 14:11-12 repeatedly pair reliance with 'upon Allah'; 14:20 reuses 'upon Allah' after the expulsion threat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated frame, harm, and expulsion; I infer that 14:20 grounds the earlier reliance. The alternative is that the shared preposition is formulaic.

changed_reading.before: The statement reports ability without a human posture.
changed_reading.after: The future entrusted to Allah under injury and expulsion is not too hard for him.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rulers' claim to expel messengers from 'our land' is reversed by destruction and resettlement after them, so no possessive regime makes succession inaccessible to Allah.

activation_trace.role: The inaccessible branch tests whether claimed territory can lie beyond divine reach.
The outward-expulsion branch supplies attempted control of habitation.
The clinging-to-land branch sharpens the rulers' possessive attachment.
The destruction branch removes the group claiming exclusive control.
The inhabiting branch supplies installation of successors.
The before-and-after branch orders destruction and resettlement as succession.

structural_cues: 14:13-14 answers expulsion from claimed land with destruction and settlement after the claimants.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies territorial expulsion, destruction, and subsequent settlement; I infer that this succession is an earlier-scale instance of 14:19-20. Alternatively, 14:19 may refer only to total creation.

changed_reading.before: Replacement is an abstract creative possibility.
changed_reading.after: No population has an unassailable title to land that can block divine succession.

context_deltas.mechanism: Coercive tyrants fail, and the weak discover that the self-exalting cannot avail them or find an exit; prestige and domination do not amount to Aziz resistance against Allah.

activation_trace.role: The strength-and-honor branch anchors apparent status and power.
The failed-attainment branch supplies collapse of the tyrant's bid.
The coercive-domination branch supplies the human form of resistant power.
The weakness branch exposes the lower side of the hierarchy.
The rank-and-prestige branch supplies superiority mistaken for power.
The sufficiency branch is negated in the leaders' inability to avail.
The turning-aside branch closes the route of escape.

structural_cues: 14:15 names the failed coercive figure; 14:21 decomposes hierarchy into weak followers, self-exalting leaders, failed aid, and no exit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coercion, prestige, failed aid, and blocked escape; I infer that these enact the focus root's honor branch socially. Alternatively, the scenes may illustrate judgment without defining 14:20.

changed_reading.before: The thing does not overpower Allah in an unspecified sense.
changed_reading.after: Neither coercive rule nor elite prestige makes a people politically untouchable by divine replacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: Even the complete human collective creates no dependency in Allah; his self-sufficiency means the present population is not a scarce asset because another creation can be originated.

activation_trace.role: The rare-and-hard-to-replace branch supplies the question of indispensability.
The complete-totality branch extends the claim to all inhabitants together.
The self-sufficiency branch removes dependence on that collective.
The originating branch supplies the available alternative creation.

structural_cues: 14:8 imagines universal human disbelief yet predicates self-sufficiency of Allah; 14:19 states removal and new creation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies total human refusal, divine self-sufficiency, and alternative creation; I infer that nondependence makes the collective replaceable. Alternatively, 14:8 may concern only disbelief's irrelevance to praise.

changed_reading.before: A new creation is simply within divine power.
changed_reading.after: The present human collective is not a rare or indispensable resource whose loss constrains Allah.

context_deltas.mechanism: Rooted stability is reversed by uprooting, a claim of no removal is exposed, mountains shift, and the earth is substituted; created solidity never becomes absolute resistance.

activation_trace.role: The cohesive-hard-ground branch anchors material resistance.
The enduring-fixity branch supplies created stability.
The whole-root extraction branch reverses apparent stability.
The removal-from-state branch is denied by speakers claiming permanence.
The same branch turns permanence into displacement in the mountain image.
The elevated-solid mass supplies the maximal image of compact resistance.
The substitution branch carries provisionality to the earth itself.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from fixed root and uprooted tree to denied removal, moving mountains, and substituted earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stability and displacement images; I infer a shared material scale testing the focus cohesion branch. Alternatively, the tree images are ethical metaphors and the mountain image hyperbole.

changed_reading.before: The task meets no generic hard obstacle.
changed_reading.after: No created fixity, from root to mountain to earth, is cohesive enough to make replacement unworkable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah blocks inference from postponement to incapacity: delay differs from heedlessness, and the promise differs from failure by renewed divine Aziz language.

activation_trace.role: The difficulty branch is the false explanation for delay.
The supposition branch marks mistaken inference about divine inaction.
The inattentive-omission branch names and rejects one explanation.
The postponement branch supplies deliberate later timing.
The failed-at-its-time branch is denied of the divine promise.
The promise branch supplies the future commitment.
The divine prevailing branch excludes external blockage.

structural_cues: 14:42 and 14:47 prohibit false reckonings about Allah, first heedlessness and then promise failure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies delay, rejected heedlessness, rejected promise failure, and divine prevailing; I infer that 14:20 separates scheduled nonoccurrence from difficulty. Delay may alternatively serve mercy, warning, or a fixed term.

changed_reading.before: Nonoccurrence might be evidence that replacement is difficult.
changed_reading.after: Deferred replacement is timed, not blocked; delay is no evidence of difficulty for Allah.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later scene converts capacity into public realization: the earth is substituted, all are exposed, and the transition terminates before the sole subduing authority.

activation_trace.role: The denied-difficulty branch begins as a capability claim.
The manifest-exposure branch makes the result public.
The substitution branch realizes replacement at earth scale.
The no-partner branch supplies singular authority over the replaced order.
The overpowering-from-above branch supplies the transition's terminal direction.

structural_cues: 14:19-20 announces possible removal and replacement; 14:48 depicts earth substitution and universal emergence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies matched replacement language and the public scene; I infer that 14:48 realizes 14:19-20's capability. Alternatively, replacing people and replacing the earth are analogous but distinct events.

changed_reading.before: The focus is a timeless statement that replacement could occur.
changed_reading.after: The focus anticipates a public cosmic transition in which the earth is replaced and all stand exposed before the sole Subduer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus branch is a pastoral physiological image rather than the normal idiom. It remains anchored in the focus predicate and is activated by water, fruit, provision, and absent cultivation; render it only as a productive-scarcity analogy, never as the lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus predicate at word 5 includes a branch of a constricted outlet and scant yield obtainable only with effort.

activation_trace.role: The constricted-yield branch supplies a source that gives little unless worked.
The water branch supplies the released productive input.
The ripe-fruit branch supplies yielded output.
The nourishing-provision branch makes the output sustaining.
The flood-channel valley supplies a site whose productive flow is potential.
The cultivation branch appears under explicit absence, sharpening scarcity.

changed_reading.before: Creation and replacement are difficult only in a general sense.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, divine production is not throttled like a constricted source, even under barren conditions.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because Aziz in the focus is not grammatically the cult-name al-Uzza. It remains root-anchored and is activated by rivals, worshipped images, and sole-deity language; label it a root-level anti-rival echo, not a translation or identification.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus root at word 5 has a branch containing al-Uzza and neighboring cultic names.

activation_trace.role: The cult-name branch opens a contained rival-power echo.
The opposing-counterpart branch supplies the falsely installed rival.
The worshipped-image branch makes the rival mechanism cultic.
The no-partner branch closes the surah by denying a real competitor.

changed_reading.before: The focus denies only abstract difficulty.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, no rival sacral power makes the threatened replacement untouchable before Allah.

strongest_changes: The demonstrative is resolved by 14:19 as removing the present people and bringing a fresh creation.
Repeated divine Aziz predicates create an asymmetry between the prevailing agent and a task that cannot prevail against him.
Historical succession, collapsed elite power, uprooting, moving mountains, and substituted earth make social and material permanence provisional.
Delay and promise language rule out interpreting nonoccurrence as inability.
14:48 moves the assertion from possible replacement to public cosmic realization.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah field tests Aziz against scarcity, coercive status, territorial possession, temporal delay, rooted matter, mountains, and the earth itself. The focus becomes a multi-domain claim that no created permanence can harden into a constraint on Allah.
remaining_uncertainties: The demonstrative may gather both removal and new creation, or point only to new creation.
Earth substitution in 14:48 may instantiate 14:19 directly or be a larger analogy.
The reliance linkage may be rhetorical rather than syntactic.
The constricted-yield and al-Uzza activations must remain exploratory.
